how_to_rerun: uv run python scripts/export_site.py, then uv run python scripts/export_site_tools.py
unknown: null in the JSON files, 65535 in access.bin; never 0

areas.order: the ids of site/data/cells.json, as it was when this ran
areas.ids_sha256_what: SHA-256 of the ids joined by a line feed, in order
areas.what: access.bin follows this order. The JSON files name areas by id.

layout.sites: [{name, other_names, kind, lat, lon, hemisphere, basis (area or latitude), basis_text, area (id or null), in_search, ranked, region, snow_status, snow_measured, source, targets{id: ...}}]
layout.targets (basis area): {hours {sun, snow, hills, cloud}, step, costliest, costliest_loss_h, percentile_among_ranked, rank_from_top, ranked_cells, verdict, sentence}
layout.targets (basis latitude): {step, hours_a_year_in_band, longest_spell_minutes, longest_spell_h, hours_in_spells_of_2h, has_a_2h_spell, sentence}
layout.step: sun, snow, hills, cloud, holds-up or null; labels in step_labels and step_labels_south

famous.json.feeds: feature 1, the box of famous sites under the short lists

layout.line: the one line under the calendar and the map
layout.check_figures: the two check figures, null without checks.json
layout.checks: more figures of the two checks
layout.link: the link to the checks section

basis.json.feeds: feature 2, what the numbers rest on

layout.entries: rows in the order of columns

layout.label: the button text
layout.reduced_motion: what to do with reduced motion

layout.order: area (the order of ids in cells.json), then the four columns
layout.columns_what: index into airfields.json airfields and whole km, for the nearest airfield with scheduled flights and the nearest airfield of any kind

access.bin.feeds: feature 12, the nearest airfield in every list row and on the place card; the reachable-only switch

layout.airfields: [{name, ident, country, type, lat, lon, municipality, scheduled}]
layout.source: the airport table and its licence

airfields.json.feeds: feature 12, the airfield names behind access.bin

layout.leads: {id, lat, lon, region, bare_km2, winter_hours_flat, winter_hours_snow_free, winter_hours_after_terrain, best_ten_day_periods, snow_land_pixels, snow_block_pixels}
layout.cautions: short sentences to print with the list

winter_leads.json.feeds: feature 12, the winter list for small bare patches

files_what: The files this run made. Read a file only when it is listed here.
